name: genomic-coordinate-assembly-and-variant-gates
intent: Prevent coordinate and allele drift by binding every transformation and comparison to declared assemblies, contigs, orientation, normalization, and provenance.
successCondition: Stop when every retained record has one validated assembly coordinate representation and every rejected mapping has a reason.
inputs: variant and coordinate records with provenance
reference assembly contig and orientation metadata
operations: validate assembly contig coordinate system and allele orientation
perform bounded assembly transformation with chain provenance
reject ambiguous failed or nonunique mappings
preconditions: every record has or can earn an explicit reference build
reference assets and coordinate conventions are exact
positiveTriggers: Reconcile genomic coordinates and variants across declared assemblies.
Gate a variant workflow on reference build normalization and provenance.
negativeTriggers: Combine coordinates whose reference build is unknown.
Provide clinical or personalized genomic conclusions.
failureModes: stop on unknown reference build or coordinate convention
exclusions: does not silently coerce assemblies or allele orientation
terminationConditions: Stop when every retained record has one validated assembly coordinate representation and every rejected mapping has a reason.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-athena route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
